text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, Suzuka. It's your 
once-a-year special day, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now, here's a question for you. On this 
special day, what sort of passionate event 
should one undertake as a personal 
challenge?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Your hints are: precious, happy, and for 
me! In other words, the ultimate gift to 
myself, perfect for the day I was brought 
into this world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, not just sweets, but mission trials 
provide a nice bit of spice as well, don't 
you think?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not really sure, but... Is it 
running?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Heh... here is my answer, then.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Perfect, Suzuka! You understand your own 
dream so clearly.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's a birthday, after all, so no 
formalities needed— mou mantai. Following 
wherever your passion leads is always the 
just answer.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So, my present to you this year, Suzuka, 
is a race against me once again! Let's 
enjoy some Unbreakable Happy!
